name: everymcp
description: 177 native tools for mathematics, geometry, binary analysis, files, and Windows host automation.

interface.longDescription: Run 177 native tools for exact arithmetic, vectors, matrices, geometry, PE analysis, binary inspection, archives, structured data, images, and Windows processes. Includes the Windows x64 executable and requires a desktop session with local execution. Tools run with your account's permissions; file changes, process control, commands, and network requests occur only when those tools are called.
defaultPrompt: Inspect this process and its loaded modules.
Compare these files and check this ZIP archive.
